trace.final:
Done. Here's a summary of what I did:

1. **Diagnosed**: checkout-api was on v2.3.1, which was failing health checks in all three production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an 18% error rate.

2. **Rolled back**: Identified v2.3.0 as the most recent previously healthy production release and rolled it out to all regions. No change-manager approval was needed since v2.3.0 had already been healthy in production.

3. **Verified**: The service is now healthy again in all regions with the error rate down to 0.2%.

4. **Opened incident**: Created SEV2 incident **INC-0001** (which paged the on-call engineer) describing the health check failures and therollback actions taken, with a follow-up note to root-cause the v2.3.1 failure before redeploying it.
